claims.statement: SLA attainment fell from 0.90 to 0.75 ratio units, a -0.15 ratio-unit change, for the complete current UTC reporting week versus the previous complete week.

The entire -0.15 ratio-unit change is explained by within-segment rate deterioration (-0.15); the mix effect is 0.00 ratio units. Priority and standard each declined from 0.90 to 0.75, while each remained 50% of the eligible denominator in both weeks.
Eligible inbound tickets increased from 1,000 to 2,000, but the outcome is driven by the SLA attainment drop rather than volume alone.

analysis.summary: Notify the business owner: SLA attainment is 0.75 ratio units this complete UTC week versus 0.90 previously, down 0.15 ratio units and past the -0.05 notification threshold. The symmetric decomposition attributes 0.00 ratio units to mix and -0.15 to within-segment deterioration; both priority and standard declined from 0.90 to 0.75.
